title: Context Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev context <story-id> --phase <specify|develop|review> --json` (Story 4.1): a deterministic, token-budgeted projection of priority-ordered sections from the hydrated cache plus entity files. Sections use the documented chars/4 token estimator; the budget walk trims or drops lowest-priority sections first and records each in `truncated` (drop order). `stats` is present only when `--stats` is requested. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

id.description: The target story id — the only accepted entity kind.

budget.description: The effective token budget: `--budget` or the phase default (specify 800, develop 1200, review 2500).

total_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the emitted payload (sum of the sections' emitted tokens). May exceed `budget` only via the first-section exemption.

sections.description: Sections in priority order (priority 1 = highest). The set depends only on the phase; an empty section is still present with `(none)` content. Sections the budget dropped entirely are absent here and named in `truncated`.

truncated.description: Sections trimmed or dropped by the budget walk, in drop order (lowest priority first), with each section's full pre-trim token count.

stats.description: Present only when `--stats` is requested; the key is omitted otherwise.

priority.description: 1-based priority rank within the phase; sections are emitted in ascending order.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the content actually emitted (after any line-trim).

truncated.description: True when the budget walk trimmed this section's lines.

content.description: The section text; `(none)` when the section has no data.

tokens.description: The section's full pre-trim token estimate — what the agent is owed.

over_budget.description: True when the total exceeds the budget (possible only via the first-section exemption).
